sections.notes: Put-in Buzzard Bluff Access: exact agency access pin. Take-out Wilbur Allen Memorial Conservation Area: exact agency access pin. Missouri law: no glass beverage containers on canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in a sealed non-glass cooler; carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat; children under 7 wear life jackets.
